fit: oral aqueous tarragon extract and sprint performance
assessment: The recreationally trained men received creatine in both crossover periods. Peak power, mean power and work had no clear group-by-time interaction. Clinical fatigue and dried culinary tarragon were unmeasured.

fit: ethanolic tarragon extract and voluntary exercise metabolism
assessment: Obese mice receiving extract had greater fat oxidation during matched wheel-running bouts. The study does not provide a fatigue outcome and the published corrigendum is open.

fit: oral tarragon supplement and systolic blood pressure
assessment: Systolic pressure declined within the tarragon arm. The abstract gives no between-arm change estimate, postural protocol or orthostatic symptom measure.
